title: yellow-yellow shattering middle-eastern chickpeas tagine
description: a floral, shattering, one-pot middle-eastern dish featuring almond essence and a sweet glaze, ideal for weeknights and vegan-friendly diets.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality extra virgin olive oil

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
add the cumin, coriander, paprika, and salt. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
add the chickpeas, almond essence, and honey. Stir to combine.
bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
season with salt to taste, then serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
